set.body:
Need (storyatlas4s Recall Voyage, 2026-09-03): the group-index track is a step function of
recall time (which scene each unit was placed in); the lowering emits every horizontal run as its
own `Lines` grob because `Lines` only joins the given points. A step interpolation on `Lines`
(`Interpolation.StepAfter | StepBefore | Linear`) would make a track one grob, one name, one path.
Low priority: the explicit form works and is deterministic.

Acceptance: the SVG path for a step line equals the explicit-point form byte for byte for the same
data; Canvas draws the same segments; the default stays Linear.
set.title: [Intaglio 1.x][Scene] Step interpolation for Lines (step-after / step-before)
